pages.title: Fine Print
pages.text: Carry a populated spell Scroll and Arcane Essence.

pages.title: Fine Print
pages.text: Read the spell’s school, level, mana cost and cooldown before experimenting.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look for spell scrolls in the installed magical loot and their listed native acquisition routes. A blank scroll does not count; examine the populated scroll’s tooltip.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The scroll must contain an actual spell; check name, level and rarity.
